mechanism_and_adoption.not_observed: Neither trajectory requested a forbidden source read or attempted pending submission. Their rejected paths are established by zero-model engineering replay,not by these two successful model runs.
mechanism_and_adoption.repeat_initial_candidate: At request4,candidate001 was saved with pending evidence and eligible=false. After request6 structured verify,request7 saved candidate002 eligible=true. Both candidates and their identical artifact digests remain preserved.
mechanism_and_adoption.deterministic_artifact: Two independent native sessions produced the same11305-byte script and1728-byte array through the same public deterministic exporter/helper. This supports actual helper adoption;it is not two independently invented extraction algorithms or copied provider responses.
mechanism_and_adoption.no_isolated_causal_claim: Original raw scores were already true. These results establish two fresh valid deliveries and observed query-only development under the revised bundle;they do not isolate effects of untriggered guards or prove a raw-score improvement.

identity_and_cost.scope: Old17 IDs were read directly from their closed traces. Additional comparisons reuse explicit identities retained in the listed review metadata;count-only fields do not establish additional UID coverage. No new live core or NVI records were opened.
identity_and_cost.actual_fee_evidence: Each fresh response has its own real rawUsage.credit=0 on the correct hy4-flash-free provider identity;each native request has attempt1/configured64000. Cumulative receipt histories are not counted as new calls.
identity_and_cost.legacy_cost_metric_scope: The inherited inspect_run metrics contain provider_reported_cost_usd=0. The direct native receipt evidence preserved here is credit=0;this review does not invent a separate native USD receipt or count historical unknowns as zero.

original_and_capture_consistency.original_grades: Each actual original verifier reward1,one test_stolen_matrix_matches passed,no exception;no new grader was run by this review.
original_and_capture_consistency.observed_bytes_boundary: Stable hashes before/after registered checks,eligible saves,final reports and post-agent native capture. The review does not claim to instrument every hidden-verifier filesystem write.

findings.detail: Retain candidate001 eligible=false/pending and candidate002 eligible=true after requested verify;this was corrected within the same fixed model session,not a scored resampling.
Actual model behavior did not exercise rejection paths;no claim that these untriggered paths caused success.

claim_limits: The access check covers recognized patterns and is not an OS sandbox. Query-only conclusions here come from the complete observed structured/executed records and delivered source audit.
The script depends on numpy and the provided forward callable,as the public task permits. It contains the full numerical helper and imports no course-tools module.

Fresh-query consistency and this one frozen target's original pass do not certify all hidden units or general extraction completeness;helper diagnostics explicitly retain completeness_certified=false and sign/scale ambiguity.
Independent native sessions and fresh receipts do not imply diverse algorithms:the exporter and final artifacts are deterministic and identical.

This review covers only the two fixed ReLU revision trials. Other149-or-later core records,unknown34,MiniMax qualifications and auxiliary NVIDIA cohorts remain separate;no whole75/225 success is inferred.
